summary: Validated the 3 new UX features (swap button, native names, searchable comboboxes) end-to-end. Backend regression 8/8 pytest passed. Frontend: source combobox opens Popover+Command, search 'jap' filters to Japanese, selecting sets source to 'Japanese · 日本語' and left panel to 'ORIGINAL — JAPANESE'. Target combobox has 13 langs, search 'spa' filters to Spanish, selecting sets 'Spanish · Español' and right panel 'TRANSLATION — SPANISH'. Swap flow: set source=French, target=Spanish, click swap-languages-button -> source becomes 'Spanish · Español', target becomes 'French · Français', panels update to ORIGINAL — SPANISH / TRANSLATION — FRENCH, controls badge shows 'SPANISH → FR'. Pressing START posted EXACTLY {"target_language":"fr"} to /api/realtime-session (network capture). Swap disabled when source=auto (verified True), enabled after concrete source. Native names visible in all button labels and dropdown rows. OpenAI /calls returns 429 insufficient_quota (external), app surfaces error-banner gracefully and reverts to START.

integration_issues.issue: 429 insufficient_quota — external OpenAI account has no credits. App handles gracefully (error-banner shown, PC torn down, START restored).

e2e_observations.error_banner_text_prefix: Failed to connect to OpenAI Realtime (429). ... no credits remaining ...
e2e_observations.controls_disabled_while_active: Wired via disabled={active}/swapDisabled in Console.jsx (verified in code). After the fast 429 error the app reverts to inactive so controls read as enabled again (expected).

action_items: Add credits to the OpenAI org tied to OPENAI_API_KEY — same external blocker as iterations 2/3. No app code change required.
critical_code_review_comments: LanguageCombobox filter encodes value as `${name}|${native}|${code}` — so search matches on English name, native endonym, or ISO code. Good UX.

Console.jsx swapLanguages() correctly maps source English name -> target ISO via sourceToTargetCode, and target ISO -> source English name via targetToSourceCode. Swap disabled when sourceLang==='auto' — correct.
Popover uses Radix `--radix-popover-trigger-width` so dropdown matches trigger width — good.
Minor: swap button title says 'Set a specific source language to swap' when disabled; could be more explicit but acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Swap button, native names, and searchable comboboxes all fully wired and verified. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_translatebox.py — remember to export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before running pytest (it's in frontend/.env, not backend env). Playwright note: use `[cmdk-item]:has-text("...")` to click combobox options after `wait_for_timeout(300)` post-open. OpenAI account still has 0 credits — /calls returns 429; funding the org is the only remaining action.
rca of the issue: No app-side issue. Only failure is external OpenAI 429 insufficient_quota. Mitigation: fund the OpenAI org.
